requirements.requirement: Independent real dependency payloads, complete locks, CycloneDX SBOMs and publisher provenance; normal application producers.
One complete set and one explicit Linux platform; canonical pinned remote/local inputs; no inferred languages or resolution.
Exact compressed app/dependency descriptors and diff IDs, layer ordering, launch preservation and deterministic output content.
All four languages run real dependencies on pinned unchanged upstream roots; HTTP, Exec/probe parity, non-root, read-only files and resources are observed.
Configured candidate compatibility tests execute separately before native workload update; signatures never imply test approval.
Dependency-only replacement preserves app/build/launch evidence, replaces normal processes and observes actual old/new image cohorts with controlled availability.
Normal production task/root cleanup, host restoration, finalizer/claim release and exact-owned fixture destruction.
Read-only explicit-scope fleet export correlates protected running app/config/manifest identities, owner UIDs and package/file/PURL/SBOM evidence for external tooling.
Explicit production/development policy separates publisher and composer authorization; invalid present signatures never become unsigned fallback.
Key rotation, validity/expiry, revocation, signer identity and exact allowed/denied subjects are enforced.
Input/source/output platforms and index membership are verified; ambiguous members and wrong sizes/config mirrors fail.
Managed-file/ancestor shadowing, symlink redirects, ordinary/opaque whiteouts and file injection fail without semantic language inference.
Only verified signed prior composition identifies replaceable dependency layers; arbitrary stripping and unsigned annotation authority fail.
Explicit launch replacement is validated and original/input/effective launch evidence and optional runtime allowlist semantics stay distinct.
Required validation/signing failures publish no accepted output or successful receipt; remote tags follow referrer/supporting-graph publication.
Immutable supporting OCI graphs, all required referrers and parent evidence survive registry transport/native or fallback discovery without credential crossing.
Versioned signed final-manifest subject binds source roots/members, platform, app descriptors/diff IDs, set/config/lock/SBOM, launch order, output config and parent.
Inspection separates structure, publisher provenance, composition signature and unevaluated external test approval; no invented Ratify/admission integration.
Optional Maven producer retains BOM/graph/scope/classifier/hash checks and thin-JAR validation; app-only output retains honest original build metadata.
Native release/GitOps updates and rollback remain external/current-policy controlled; no restart loop, hot swap, CRD or second shim pull.
Unknown/missing evidence, registry failures, invalid signatures, stale observations and ambiguous runtime/config identities report unverified, not clean.
Scoped affected/control/staging and shared-image cohorts remain distinguishable; labels do not establish workload ownership.
Exported standard SBOM/PURL facts support external advisory tools without a Brewlet scanner, database, naive version comparator or unsupported clean claim.
Document producer/layout/trust/operator/remediation workflows and explicit input rejection, scope, permission and unchanged-runtime qualification limits.
Native architectures are separate; failures remain failures and prior 111 obligations are not relabeled as new feature acceptance.
Both Wasmtime and Spin consume independently signed complete external bundles through signed compose/verify, rejecting wrong trust and managed-path conflicts.

Actual guest behavior changes after external dependency replacement while .wasm hashes, application/launch bytes and read-only/cache/security boundaries remain unchanged; no compiled-in remediation claim.
Native Deployment rollout follows candidate checks, replaces old Pod/container cohorts and exports actual dependency/SBOM identities; controlled HTTP availability is qualified for Spin only.
Selected platform-built host source/epoch/generation remains unchanged across bundle updates, with actual host provenance, separate native architectures and normal cleanup/owned destruction.
